messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: inference-gateway v2.14.0 -> live in prod us-west-2. Post-deploy run: warm-prefill, kv-warmup, synth-checks. Results: warm-prefill OK, kv-warmup partial, synth-checks 1/3 failing (latency high). See run id: run-2026-03-21-1123. Rolling HF? :warning:

alex chan: Saw p95 jump ~120ms on embed route, baseline 60ms. Also small increase in CPU on gw-host-3. Linking quick trace: https://tracing.redwood/trace/xyz :eyes:

maya r.: Running targeted synth now to repro. Command: curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_KEY' https://api.redwood/v1/infer -d '{"input":"prefill test"}' | jq .latency

eli (sre): Thanks. Also check `kubectl top pod gw-3 -n prod` and `kubectl logs gw-3 -c inference` for spikes. If KV warmup didn't finish, we may see p99 token stall.

tj: I grabbed kubectl logs — saw repeated WARN about `kv_prefill` starting 2m after rollout. Snippet: ```WARN kv_prefill.go:112 prefill incomplete: 12/16 shards```

alex chan: Given synth fail + kv prefill warning, propose pin traffic back to v2.13.9 for affected routes (embed, chat) and let rollout finish on rest. Thoughts?

maya r.: :thumbsup: +1. Can we do a partial traffic pin? @ops, can you apply route-split -> 90/10 to old version?

deploy-bot: Action: created rollback ticket #R-4591 and started traffic-shift run-1758888123. To confirm, run `releasesctl rollback --service inference-gateway --version v2.13.9 --routes embed,chat --reason "kv-prefill partial"`

eli (sre): I'll monitor. If no regression in 10m, we can continue rollout after KV prefill completes. Setting alert: `synth-failure > 5` to page on-call.

tj: Also filing follow-up to improve prefill wait with `--wait-kv=true` in CI. Short term: pin & finish prefill.

alex chan: Thanks team. I'll post notes to release channel and update release notes with the pin decision.
